title.zh: Inside AMD and Anthropic’s ‘chips for shares’ deal
title.en: Inside AMD and Anthropic’s ‘chips for shares’ deal

current_state.zh: Anthropic and AMD have structured a multi-billion-dollar deal in which Anthropic commits to over $20 billion in AMD AI compute services while AMD pledges up to $5 billion to purchase Anthropic stock, raising concerns about circular financing tied to Anthropic’s IPO prospectus.
